title: GroupChats
description: This plugin for Paper 1.21.11 allows you to create so called ChatGroups were you can chat in a group
body:
This plugin is **lightweight and super easy to use** and made for **Paper(includes Spigot, Bukkit) 1.21.11** but other versions might be supported too

### What it does:
This plugin allows you to create group chats in wich you can chat in private groups(this means that the global chat can't see what you're writing,but only the people wich are in youre same group) without having to type /msg all the time. So it basically is like a voicechat group without talking.

After having setup the group like expalined in the commands section below you'll just be able to write it down in global chat (it won't be read) the message will than be redirected to all you're group members

### Commands:
> /createg <group name> - creates a chat group

> /inviteg <player name> - invites a player to the group

> /acceptg - accepts pending requestes

> /delplayerg <player name> - deletes a player from the group,this can be you're self too

> /exitg - removes you from the group - a shortcut for /deleteplayerg <you're name> 

> /publicg - displays all public groups

### Other features:
after launching the Server for the first time a Folder named GroupChat with in it a config file will appear you can add there so called default groups

This is useful if you wanna make Groups for every language
